searchTitle.description: Search by title (convenience filter, wraps in title:*...*). Use 'query' for advanced filtering.

query.description: Raw query string for advanced filtering (e.g. 'status:active vendor:Nike tag:sale')

handle.description: URL slug, e.g. 'black-sunglasses'. Auto-generated from title if omitted.

seo.description: SEO title and description for search engines

collectionsToJoin.description: Collection GIDs to add the product to

seo.description: SEO title and description for search engines

collectionsToJoin.description: Collection GIDs to add the product to

collectionsToLeave.description: Collection GIDs to remove the product from

redirectNewHandle.description: If true, old handle redirects to new handle

id.description: Variant GID for updates. Omit to create new.

compareAtPrice.description: Compare-at price for showing discounts, e.g. '79.00'

sku.description: SKU for the variant (mapped to inventoryItem.sku)

tracked.description: Whether inventory is tracked. Set false for print-on-demand.

strategy.description: Strategy for handling the standalone 'Default Title' variant when creating. DEFAULT removes it automatically.

variantIds.description: Array of variant GIDs to delete

variantStrategy.description: Strategy for variant creation when adding options. LEAVE_AS_IS (default) keeps existing variants, CREATE generates new variant combinations.

query.description: Raw query string for advanced filtering (e.g. 'financial_status:paid fulfillment_status:shipped')

variantId.description: Product variant GID. Required for existing products, omit for custom line items.

title.description: Title for custom line items (ignored when variantId is set)

originalUnitPriceWithCurrency.description: Custom price for custom line items

taxable.description: Whether custom line item is taxable

requiresShipping.description: Whether custom line item requires shipping

lineItems.description: Line items (max 499). Use variantId for existing products or title+price for custom items.

customerId.description: Customer GID to associate with the draft order

taxExempt.description: Whether the draft order is tax exempt

valueType.description: Whether value is fixed or percentage

draftOrderId.description: The draft order GID, e.g. gid://shopify/DraftOrder/123

refund.description: Whether to refund to the original payment method

action.description: Whether to close or open the order

id.description: The fulfillment order line item GID

fulfillmentOrderLineItems.description: Specific line items to fulfill. If omitted, all line items are fulfilled.

lineItemsByFulfillmentOrder.description: Fulfillment orders and their line items to fulfill

company.description: Tracking company name (use exact Shopify-known names)

notifyCustomer.description: Whether to send shipping notification to customer

lineItemId.description: The line item GID to refund

restockType.description: How to restock: CANCEL (not yet fulfilled), RETURN (already fulfilled), NO_RESTOCK

notify.description: Whether to send refund notification to customer

currency.description: Currency code if different from shop currency (presentment currency)

searchQuery.description: Freetext search or Shopify query syntax (e.g. 'country:US tag:vip orders_count:>5')

customerIdOfFirstNameToKeep.description: Customer GID whose first name to keep

customerIdOfLastNameToKeep.description: Customer GID whose last name to keep

customerIdOfEmailToKeep.description: Customer GID whose email to keep

customerIdOfPhoneNumberToKeep.description: Customer GID whose phone to keep

customerIdOfDefaultAddressToKeep.description: Customer GID whose default address to keep

note.description: Note to keep on the merged customer

tags.description: Tags to keep on the merged customer

overrideFields.description: Override default merge rules for specific fields

addressId.description: Address GID (required for update and delete)

address.description: Address fields (required for create and update)

setAsDefault.description: Set this address as the customer's default

GID of the resource (product, order, customer, variant, etc.)

namespace.description: Metafield namespace. If omitted, app-reserved namespace is used.

key.description: Unique identifier within its namespace (2-64 chars)

value.description: The value to set (always stored as string)

type.description: Metafield type, e.g. 'single_line_text_field', 'json', 'number_integer'. Required if no definition exists.

metafields.description: Metafields to set (max 25). Works on any resource: products, orders, customers, variants, collections, etc.

ownerId.description: GID of the resource that owns the metafield

metafields.description: Metafields to delete, identified by owner + namespace + key

id.description: GID of the resource (order, product, customer, draft order, or article)

action.description: Whether to add or remove the tags

quantities.description: Quantities to set for each inventory item at each location

ignoreCompareQuantity.description: Skip compare-and-set check (default true for simplicity)

ownerType.description: The resource type to get metafield definitions for (e.g. PRODUCT, ORDER, CUSTOMER). Note: Some Shopify types use concatenated names without underscores (PRODUCTVARIANT not PRODUCT_VARIANT, DRAFTORDER not DRAFT_ORDER, CARTTRANSFORM not CART_TRANSFORM). Underscore aliases are accepted and normalized automatically.

first.description: Number of definitions to return (default 50, max 100)

includeInactive.description: Whether to include deactivated locations (default false)
